## Change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Describe missing prerequisites
or untested platforms; do not count skipped tests as a pass.

## Relevant compatibility

Mention effects on shared media behavior, cancellation, existing outputs,
CLI/MCP compatibility and the seven GUI translations, where applicable.

Do not include credentials, personal media or unredacted logs. For vulnerabilities,
use the private reporting procedure in SECURITY.md.
